description: Qwen3.8-27B OFFICIAL FP8 quantization (HF Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8, revision 017b9c7af6b5689d5dd426a76e0bc077eb5ca20a), acquired 2026-08-26 and published to B2: 78 objects, 30,889,971,234 B = 28.77 GiB, 66 shards. Scheme read off the checkpoint's OWN quantization_config, not a doc: quant_method fp8, fmt e4m3, activation_scheme dynamic, weight_block_size [128,128] — fine-grained BLOCK-wise weights carried as 407 *.weight_scale_inv tensors, not a per-tensor cast. 1,606 tensors = 1,251 text + 333 model.visual.* + 22 mtp.*, counted from this snapshot's own model.safetensors.index.json. The vision tower is NOT quantized (every model.visual.* / visual.* linear is in modules_to_not_convert, 882 entries), nor are lm_head, embed_tokens, the norms, the MoE gates or the linear-attn state params (A_log/conv1d/dt_bias/in_proj_a|b|ba); the MTP head's GEMMs ARE quantized, which is why it carries 22 tensors here against the bf16 snapshot's 15. NOT INTERCHANGEABLE WITH qwen38-27b, and the difference is not a repacking: these are different numerics and a different artifact (28.77 GiB vs 51.769 GiB, 66 shards vs 18, 1,606 tensors vs 1,199). A number measured on one is not a number measured on the other. It is also a SERVING artifact and is NOT trainable — finegrained-fp8's is_trainable is hard-False — so a training or relayout-merge run must name the bf16 id. `family` is `qwen38-27b` — the ARCHITECTURE family, which is what the field means; it is not a claim that this artifact is mergeable. family_specs/ is the MERGE PUBLISHER's family list (every spec there must declare a total merge block and merge-publish-v1 must include them all), so a spec for an unmergeable serving artifact does not belong in it. Naming the bf16 family is safe because the mismatch is FAIL-LOUD, not silent: that spec's index.expect_tensors is 1,199 and this checkpoint has 1,606, so any merge attempt against this dir is refused by the geometry gate rather than quietly producing a wrong model.
